in_hebrew.name: Coleen
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Coleen הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old Irish name Colleen meaning 'hazel-eyed'. This name was popularized in Ireland during the 19th century and has since become a common name for Irish girls.

in_greek.name: Coleen
in_greek.long_meaning: Coleen είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old Irish name Colleen meaning 'hazel-eyed'. This name was popularized in Ireland during the 19th century and has since become a common name for Irish girls.

in_latin.name: Coleen
in_latin.long_meaning: Coleen est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old Irish name Colleen meaning 'hazel-eyed'. This name was popularized in Ireland during the 19th century and has since become a common name for Irish girls.
